title: Backwaters
text: **Grace’s corner** Feeling a bit silly for organising a beautiful shikara (a small boat, good for navigating skinny canals) cruise for 6am. I thought it would be a good time to see some birds. I clearly did not think about the fact that I would be incredibly tired and the shikara would gently rock me to sleep. I fell asleep for a good hour twenty, and when I woke up we were back where we had started. Luckily for me, I caught the end of it and Rushan captured some beautiful shots. It also was an incredible nap.
